topic: Cross-reference for case in fused relatives
claim: The text refers to “the discussion of case in fused relatives, Ch. 12, §5.3”.
evidence_summary: Ch. 12 §5 is “Infinitival relative clauses” and has no subsections. Case in fused relatives is under §6.3 (p. 1073). Page 332 cites §6.3 correctly. The authors’ errata correct a similar reference on p. 269 from §5.4 to §6.4.
inference: Does the reference lead to the cited discussion?

evidence.example: Ch. 12, pp. 1067 and 1073. Authors’ errata, p. 269 entry.
evidence.establishes: A reference left over from earlier section numbering.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
